blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) is a foundation model for image and video segmentation that sets the state of the art in visual object tracking. Its tracker, inherited from SAM 2, stores information from past frames in a memory bank, managed by a simple First-In-First-Out rule, allowing temporal consistency in complex videos. Several recent methods improve SAM 2 with hand-crafted memory update rules, each targeting a specific failure mode, such as distractors, occlusions, or object motion. However, their gains transfer only partially to the stronger SAM 3 backbone. We instead present a more general, data-driven approach that frames memory control as a sequential decision-making task. SAM3RL is an extension of the SAM 3 tracker with a lightweight memory controller, trained by reinforcement learning, that decides which frames enter the memory bank in order to maximize tracking performance. SAM3RL sets a new state of the art on 10 of 12 tracking and video object segmentation benchmarks, outperforming all hand-crafted rules without any runtime overhead. The same approach applied to SAM 2 gives SAM2RL, which outperforms hand-crafted rules on 9 of the 12 benchmarks, showing the generality of our method across model generations.

SAM3RL在12个跟踪和视频物体分块基准中的10个设定了新的最新技术,在没有任何运行时间高空的情况下,超过了所有手工操作的规则. 适用于SAM 2的同样方法赋予了SAM2RL,它的表现超过了12个基准中的9个的手工制作规则,显示了我们的方法跨模范代的通用性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Visual object tracking is a fundamental computer vision task in which a tracker is given a target object in the first frame of a video and must localize it, as a box or a segmentation mask, in all subsequent frames. Reliable tracking is a key component of applications such as autonomous driving, robotics, video surveillance, and sports analytics ( Marvasti-Zadeh et al., 2022 ) . The task remains difficult since the target may be surrounded by visually similar distractors, be occluded for long periods, or change its appearance. These challenges are amplified in long videos, where errors can accumulate over time and recovery depends critically on historical context ( Javed et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 视觉物体跟踪是一项基本的计算机视觉任务,其中追踪器在视频的第一帧中被赋予了目标对象,并且必须在后续所有帧中将其定位为盒子或分片口罩. 可靠追踪是自主驾驶,机器人,视频监控,运动分析等应用的关键组成部分(Marvasti-Zadeh等,2022年). 这项任务仍然很困难,因为目标可能被视觉上类似的分心器所包围,长时间被占据,或者改变外观. 挑战在长视频中被放大, 错误会随时间而累积,

blocks.en:
Recent state-of-the-art trackers are built on the Segment Anything Model (SAM) family.
SAM 2 ( Ravi et al., 2025 ) is a promptable video segmentation model that conditions each mask prediction on features from past frames held in a small, fixed-size memory bank .
SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) targets promptable concept segmentation, while inheriting the tracker architecture from SAM 2.
The original SAM 2 populates the bank with a simple First-In-First-Out (FIFO) rule that keeps the most recent frames regardless of quality or relevance.
Therefore, a line of follow-up work replaces FIFO with hand-crafted update rules, including motion-aware frame selection ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , distractor-aware memory ( Videnović et al., 2026 ) , and calibrated prototype memory with positional priors ( Xu et al., 2025 ) ; some go further and also select among mask candidates by motion consistency ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) or maintain several banks and search over them ( Ding et al., 2025b ) .
SAM 3 also follows this approach and refines FIFO by keeping only frames in which the object is not occluded, plus the most recent frame.

blocks.en: However, each of the hand-crafted rules targets a particular failure mode, such as distractors, occlusions, or fast motion. Ideally, the tracker should be robust to all of them at the same time. Moreover, these rules are tied to the model generation they were designed for, as all heuristics developed for SAM 2 transfer poorly to the stronger SAM 3. Their gains on tracking benchmarks are limited, and on video object segmentation they even fall below SAM 3 on most benchmarks; see Figure 1 .

blocks.en:
In this work, we show that memory control should be learned rather than designed. We formulate memory control as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), designing the state, actions, and reward, but leaving the choice of what to remember to the agent.
That choice is learned by reinforcement learning (RL) directly from data, without touching the tracker itself.
We introduce SAM3RL , which applies this memory control formulation to SAM 3 and sets a new state
of the art on several tracking benchmarks, most notably on the VOTS and VOT-LT challenges.
It does so at no additional inference cost and, unlike hand-crafted rules, without sacrificing performance on video object segmentation.
Applied to SAM 2, the same recipe yields SAM2RL, which still outperforms hand-crafted rules on most benchmarks, showing the generality of our learned method across model generations.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的捐款如下:

blocks.en:
Learned memory control for SAM-based trackers. We formulate memory bank control in SAM-based trackers as an MDP over a fixed-capacity bank.
The state describes the content of the bank, the action selects the entry to evict,
and the reward scores the resulting prediction against the annotation.
This formulation allows the memory control to be learned instead of being manually designed.

状态描述银行的内容, 动作选择的条目驱逐,
报酬的分数是用来抵挡注解的。
这种配方使得内存控制能够被学习,而不是被手动设计.

blocks.en:
State-of-the-art visual object tracker. We present SAM3RL, which extends SAM 3 with a memory controller obtained by optimizing the introduced MDP with RL.
It improves over SAM 3 on 11 out of 12 benchmarks and ranks first on 10 of them.
The largest gains are achieved on the VOT(S) challenges, with + 3.6 +3.6 on VOTS 2026 {}_{\text{2026}} and + 5.5 +5.5 on VOT-LT 2022 {}_{\text{2022}} .
It is also the only tracker that consistently succeeds in video object segmentation, scoring + 1.1 +1.1 on MOSE v2 {}_{\text{v2}} and + 2.5 +2.5 on SA-V val {}_{\text{val}} .
SAM3RL achieves this while optimizing the memory control only, whereas most compared methods additionally modify mask selection, prompting, or the number of banks maintained.

blocks.en:
Online controller without a runtime penalty. The SAM3RL controller is a lightweight MLP evaluated once per memory update.
It reads only values the tracker has already computed, and stays fully online without lookahead or extra feature extraction, unlike other methods.
On tracking benchmarks, SAM3RL is faster than SAM 3, at 16.0 FPS against 15.3 FPS, as the memory is updated only every sixth frame, matching the decision rate used in training.
Under the real-time FPS constraint of VOTS-RT 2025 {}_{\text{2025}} , SAM3RL stays best at 75.1 75.1 , dropping only 1.8 1.8 points, while SAM 3 drops 4.3 4.3 .

Generality across model generations. SAM2RL is obtained by applying the same recipe to SAM 2.
It improves the baseline on all 12 benchmarks and leads on 9 of them, although every compared rule was designed specifically for SAM 2.
SAM2RL still remains faster than SAM 2, at 25.5 FPS against 25.1 FPS.
Together with SAM3RL, this demonstrates the generality of the introduced method.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Visual object tracking (VOT) and semi-supervised video object segmentation (VOS) are conditioned on a target specified in the first frame of a video, which must then be localized in all subsequent frames.
The target is represented by a bounding box in VOT and a pixel-level mask in VOS.
Both tasks require maintaining the target through appearance changes, occlusions,
fast motion, and distractors, which remain the dominant sources of tracking failure ( Kristan et al., 2020 ) . To address these challenges, trackers have long exploited information from previous frames ( Matthews et al., 2004 ; Kalal et al., 2012 ; Oh et al., 2019 ; Cui et al., 2022 ; Han and Huang, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
视觉物体跟踪(VOT)和半监督视频物体分解(VOS)以视频第一帧所指定的目标为条件,然后必须在后续所有帧中进行局部化.
目标由VOT中的边框和VOS中的像素级口罩所代表.
两项任务都要求通过外观变化,隐蔽,
快速运动和分心器,它们仍然是追踪故障的主导来源(Kristan等,2020年). 为了应对这些挑战,跟踪人员长期以来利用了以往框架的信息(Matthews等,2004年;Kalal等,2012年;Oh等,2019年;Cui等,2022年;Han和Huang,2024年)。

blocks.en:
Recently, the SAM 2 foundation model ( Ravi et al., 2025 ) set a new state of the art in tracking.
Its impact is evident in the VOTS 2026 {}_{\text{2026}} challenge, where 92% of submitted trackers were derived from the SAM family ( Kristan et al., 2026 ) .
Central to the SAM 2 design is the memory bank, a fixed-capacity store of past frames on which every prediction is conditioned by memory attention.
The bank holds seven slots, the prompted first frame and the six most recent ones, under a FIFO rule.
Because adjacent frames are highly correlated, FIFO tends to fill the bank with redundant observations rather than the diverse history required to distinguish the target from distractors or recover after occlusions.
blocks.zh:
最近,SAM 2的地基模型(Ravi等,2025年)在追踪中设定了一个新的地步.
其影响在VOTS 2026 {text{2026}的挑战中显而易见,92%的提交追踪者来自SAM家族(Kristan等,2026年)。
SAM 2设计的核心是内存库,是过去帧的固定容量存储库,每个预测都以内存关注为条件.
银行在FIFO规则下持有了7个插槽,被催生出的第一个框和最近的6个槽.
由于相邻的帧高度相关,FIFO倾向于将多余的观测结果填充到银行中来,而不是为了区分目标与分心器或被隔离后恢复所需的多样化历史.

blocks.en:
Consequently, memory design in SAM-based trackers has become an active research area, with follow-up work replacing FIFO with hand-crafted selection rules.
SAMURAI ( Yang et al., 2026 ) uses a Kalman filter ( Kalman, 1960 ) to score motion
consistency, both selecting among per-frame mask candidates and gating memory updates.
DAM4SAM ( Videnović et al., 2026 ) splits the bank into a fixed-interval part and a
part reserved for frames that resolve visually similar distractors. SAMITE ( Xu et al., 2025 ) calibrates stored prototypes and adds positional priors.
HiM2SAM ( Chen et al., 2026 ) combines hierarchical motion estimation with a
long- and short-term split of the bank.
SAM2Long ( Ding et al., 2025b ) keeps several banks in parallel and performs tree search over alternative trajectories. Even SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) relies on such a rule, retaining an unprompted frame only when the model is confident that the target is present.

blocks.en:
However, for older trackers, learned memory control has already been shown to outperform hand-crafted rules ( Choi et al., 2018 ; Yang and Chan, 2018 ; Zhang et al., 2019b ; Dai et al., 2020 ) .
Specifically for SAM 2, we attempted learning the rules instead of designing them in our preliminary work ( Adamyan et al., 2025 ) .
There, we showed the potential of learned memory control by fitting a separate RL agent to each of a handful of training videos.
Agents improve over the hand-crafted rules, but do not transfer to unseen videos.
This demonstrates a performance upper bound rather than a usable tracker.
Here, we develop the full method, a single general-purpose policy that generalizes to unseen videos, extends to SAM 3, and sets a new state of the art in visual object tracking.

blocks.en: 3.2 Training the Memory Controller
blocks.zh: 3.2 培训记忆控制员

blocks.en:
Architecture. The controller π θ \pi_{\theta} is a single MLP, which serves as the actor .
All features enter it directly, except the object pointers, which a shared linear projection first compresses to 64 dimensions.
All groups are then concatenated and passed through one hidden layer of 2,048 units and a linear head over the seven actions, about 3.2 M parameters in total.
For training, we add a critic , a second network of the same design with a scalar head, which estimates the expected return, shares no parameters with the actor, and is discarded after training.
Besides s t s_{t} , the critic receives the normalized number of decision steps left in the episode, which it needs to predict undiscounted finite-horizon returns.
This value is unavailable at inference, but since only the actor is deployed, the controller remains fully online and depends on s t s_{t} alone.

blocks.en:
Training data. We train on the LaSOT training split ( Fan et al., 2019 ) , whose 1,120 sequences are divided into 896 for training and 224 for validation, while the official test set is held out.
LaSOT is annotated with per-frame bounding boxes at 30 FPS.
Since consecutive frames at that rate are nearly identical, an eviction decision changes the bank very little while still consuming a decision step.
We therefore subsample every sixth frame, so that training episodes run at 5 FPS and span 425 decision steps on average.
This also matches the typical annotation rate of VOS datasets.

因此,我们每6个框架抽样一次,培训以5个FPS进行,平均涉及425个决策步骤。
这也符合VOS数据集的典型注释率.

blocks.en:
Optimization. We train the controller with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) , using the undiscounted Monte-Carlo return (i.e. , γ = 1 \gamma=1 ) minus the critic’s predicted value as the advantage.
The return is bootstrapped only when the rollout window truncates an episode, corresponding to λ = 1 \lambda=1 in generalized advantage estimation (GAE) ( Schulman et al., 2016 ) .
Apart from this bootstrap, we keep the critic out of the targets and use it only as a baseline, as it fits the training videos well but transfers poorly to unseen videos.
Each of the 400 iterations collects 376-step rollouts from 256 parallel environments.
Training takes about 24 hours on four H200 GPUs.
We evaluate the greedy policy on the full validation videos every 25 iterations and select the best checkpoint.
All remaining hyperparameters are listed in Table 13 in Appendix D .

blocks.en: 4 SAM3RL Performance
blocks.zh: 4 SAM3RL 性能

blocks.en:
SAM3RL sets a new state of the art among memory control methods for SAM-based trackers on most tracking and video object segmentation benchmarks.
In this section, we compare it with the prior methods discussed in Section 2 , all evaluated on the SAM 3 backbone.
Because these methods were designed for SAM 2 and their authors have not released SAM 3 implementations, we port each one to SAM 3 ourselves.
Each port replaces the SAM 2 video predictor with the SAM 3 tracker and leaves the method otherwise untouched.
We also compare the prior methods, in their original SAM 2 implementations, against SAM2RL (our memory control on SAM 2) in Figure 1 and Appendix A . Appendix B details tracker evaluation, FPS measurement, reproducibility, and the ports.

SAM3RL为基于SAM的跟踪器在大多数跟踪和视频对象分解基准上设定了内存控制方法中的新状态.

由于这些方法是为SAM 2所设计的,而他们的作者还没有发布SAM 3的实现,所以我们自己将每个方法移植到SAM 3.
每个端口将SAM 2的视频预测器替换为SAM 3的跟踪器,并留下该方法在其他方面没有被改变.
我们还比较了先前在最初的SAM 2执行中与图1和附录A中的SAM2RL(我们在SAM 2上的内存控制)的方法. 附 录 B详细介绍了跟踪器评估,FPS测量,可再生性,以及端口.

blocks.en:
The VOT initiative has organized annual tracking challenges for over a decade, and its benchmarks have evolved with the field ( Kristan et al., 2013 ) .
Current VOTS challenges unify short-term and long-term tracking with single-target and multi-target scenarios.
The sequences feature occlusions, visually similar distractors, and targets that leave the field of view and re-enter.
VOTS targets are annotated by segmentation masks and scored on a remote server, whereas VOT-LT targets are annotated by bounding boxes.
Results are presented in Table 1 .
The challenges separate the methods most sharply, with scores spanning 7.0 7.0 points on VOTS 2026 {}_{\text{2026}} .
SAM3RL ranks first on all five challenges.
Among hand-crafted rules, SAMITE3 and SAM3Long provide the strongest baselines.

blocks.en:
Model throughput is measured on VOTS 2026 and covers model inference only.
On the 30 FPS benchmarks, SAM3RL updates its memory only every s s th frame with s = 6 s=6 , matching the 5 FPS data used during training.
On the s − 1 s-1 frames in between, no memory frame is formed, so the memory encoder is skipped and the controller is not evaluated.
SAM 3, in contrast, runs the memory encoder on every frame.
The time saved on memory encoding outweighs the cost of the controller, so SAM3RL reaches 16.0 FPS, exceeding both the hand-crafted rules and the 15.3 FPS of SAM 3.
The speedup therefore comes from the less frequent memory updates rather than from the policy itself.
With memory updated on every frame where s = 1 s=1 , SAM3RL runs at 14.9 FPS; see Table 4 .

blocks.en: 5 Analysis of Learned Memory Control
blocks.zh: 5 知识记忆控制分析

blocks.en:
Memory stride. Deciding on every frame is the most flexible choice in principle, but training at 30 FPS is costly, as most decisions concern nearly identical frames.
We therefore train at 5 FPS and match that decision rate at inference with the stride s s . Table 4 shows the effect of stride on 30 FPS benchmarks.
At s = 1 s=1 , our policy runs outside its training distribution, yet still outperforms SAM 3 on all seven benchmarks, by 1.8 points on average.
At s = 6 s=6 , although only every sixth frame can enter the bank, the gain grows to 2.9 points as the decision rate matches the 5 FPS used in training.
In our evaluations, the compared methods run at their native strides, as most were developed for 30 FPS benchmarks, and DAM4SAM and HiM2SAM even adapt their stride to the benchmark frame rate, similarly to ours.
The SAM 3 paper, however, reports only VOS results at s = 1 s=1 , so we also evaluate SAM 3 at s = 6 s=6 , both with its official strided variant and as our modification SAM 3 ours {}_{\text{ours}} , which pairs SAM 3’s selection rule with our stride.
The former loses up to 10.9 points, while the latter gains 1.4 points on average.
At equal stride, SAM3RL still outperforms SAM 3 ours {}_{\text{ours}} by 1.5 points on average.

Learned memory selection. SAM 3 admits only frames whose effective IoU score exceeds a threshold.
Its bank thus acts as FIFO while the target is visible and, during absences, holds the pre-absence frames plus the most recent one. Figure 4 shows that SAM3RL instead spreads its bank further back in time and, during absences, mixes older pre-absence frames with ones from the absence itself.
Unlike SAM 3, the policy admits nearly all medium-score frames and grows more selective as the score rises, rejecting the most confident frames about as often as those predicted absent; see Figure 4 .
The policy also adapts to video content, admitting far more frames when the target moves or changes appearance, as in Figure 5 . Appendix F quantifies this effect and includes more behavior analysis.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
We presented SAM3RL, which learns memory control over a fixed-capacity bank with RL while keeping the backbone frozen. SAM3RL improves over SAM 3 on 11 of 12 benchmarks and ranks first on 10, with the largest gains on VOT(S), at virtually no runtime cost.
It is also the only method that consistently improves on video object segmentation.
Applying the same recipe to SAM 2 yields SAM2RL, which improves over SAM 2 on every benchmark and leads on 9.
These results suggest that memory control should be learned rather than designed, as learned control improves even the strongest trackers and, unlike fixed rules, remains effective across model generations.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了SAM3RL,它学习了对固定容量的银行的内存控制,同时保持了骨干被冻结. SAM3RL改进了12个基准中的11个基准中的SAM 3,并在10个基准中名列前茅,在VOT(S)方面收益最大,几乎没有运行时间成本。
这也是在视频物体分解上持续改进的唯一方法.
对SAM 2 采用同样的配方,可产生SAM2RL,它在每个基准上比SAM 2 有所改进,领先于 9.
这些结果表明,记忆控制应当被学习而不是设计,因为所学习的控制甚至会改进最强的跟踪器,并且与固定规则不同,在模范代间依然有效.

blocks.en:
Limitations. First, the policy is tied to the 5 FPS decision rate seen in training.
Deciding on every frame of 30 FPS benchmarks still improves over SAM 3, but the average gain drops from 2.9 to 1.8 points.
We therefore match the training rate with the stride s s , which requires the frame rate to be known in advance and keeps the skipped frames out of the memory bank.
The former is rarely restrictive in practice, as the frame rate is usually available.
Training at the native rate would remove this restriction, but most decisions would then concern near-identical frames.
Such a policy could nonetheless exploit the skipped frames and improve further on high-frame-rate benchmarks.
Second, the policy controls only the seven frames in the memory bank, while the nine object pointers are filled by a fixed rule.
Learning both jointly is a natural direction for future work.
blocks.zh:
限制。 首先,这项政策与培训中看到的5个FPS决定率挂钩。
确定30个FPS基准的每个框架仍然比SAM 3有所改进,但平均收益从2.9分下降到1.8分.
因此,我们把训练的速率与脚步相匹配,这需要提前知道帧速率,并且将跳出帧保留在记忆库外.
前者在实践中很少具有限制性,因为通常有帧率.
按当地费率进行的培训将消除这一限制,但大多数决定将涉及接近相同的框架。
然而,这种政策可以利用被跳出的框架,并进一步改进高基准。
第二,政策只控制内存库中的7个帧,而9个对象指针则由固定规则来填充.
共同学习是未来工作的自然方向。

We evaluate trackers in a per-object rather than joint setup. Each object is

frame. The tracker state is reset between objects. This is the only mode all

blocks.en: Appendix C Race Condition in SAM 3
blocks.zh: 附录C SAM 3中的种族条件

blocks.en:
The SAM 3 video predictor offloads per-frame tracking state to pageable host memory
with non_blocking=True and then reads that buffer on the CPU without
synchronizing, which PyTorch documents as undefined behavior. Within a single add_new_points_or_box call, the asynchronous copy of the
conditioning-frame mask is launched and the same tensor is interpolated on the
host a few lines later. If the copy did not land, the host will read the
leftovers of the previous sequence in the process. The corrupted mask is encoded
into the memory bank as frame 0, and because long-term tracking never
re-initializes, the sequence is lost from frame 1 rather than degrading over
time. The failure requires box initialization, CPU state offloading, and a
preceding sequence in the same process. We fix it by forcing CUDA → \rightarrow CPU copies to be synchronous.

Batch composition. Each rank runs 64 parallel environments, each tracking one object. They come from 16 videos, with each object copied four times.

Besides the seven memory features, the memory attention of SAM 2 and SAM 3 also reads up to sixteen object pointers, one of which always comes from the conditioning frame; see Section 3 .
SAM 2 takes the remaining pointers from the 15 most recent frames, whereas SAM 3 takes them from the most recent frames whose effective IoU score exceeds a threshold, always including the previous frame.
SAM3RL instead uses a recently evicted rule, which reads the pointers of the conditioning frame and of the six frames currently in the memory bank, and fills the remaining nine slots with the frames most recently evicted from the bank.
We also consider a longest-kept rule, which ranks evicted frames by the number of decisions they remained in the memory bank and selects the pointers of the top nine.
Unlike the rules of SAM 2 and SAM 3, both of our rules depend on the agent’s actions. Figure 7 compares all four rules within SAM3RL, reporting the LaSOT validation score of each rule every 25 training iterations; all other components are kept fixed.

我们也考虑一个最长的保存规则,它根据被拆卸的帧留在内存库中的决定数量来排序被拆卸的帧,并选择前九名的指针.

blocks.en:
After the first 200 iterations, both our action-dependent rules remain above the SAM 2 and SAM 3 rules, showing that the object pointer selection rule affects tracking performance.
Between the two, the recently evicted rule scores higher in most evaluations, but the longest-kept rule performs comparably and their seed bands overlap.
Designing better rules could improve performance further.
Moreover, since learned memory control outperforms hand-crafted rules for memory bank selection, extending the policy to also select object pointers is a natural direction for future work.

在前200次迭代后,我们的行动依赖规则都仍然高于SAM 2和SAM 3规则,表明对象指针选择规则会影响跟踪性能.
在两者之间,最近被逐出的规则在大多数评价中得分较高,但最长的规则可比较地执行,其种子带重叠。
制定更好的规则可以进一步提高业绩。
此外,由于所学的内存控制超越了记忆库选择的手工制作规则,将政策也扩展到选择对象指针是未来工作的自然方向.

Figures 11 , 12 and 13 compare the memory banks of SAM 3, DAM4SAM3, and SAM3RL around three absence gaps.
In all three, SAM3RL keeps old, temporally sparse frames and admits few new ones while the target is absent, so the pre-absence appearance is still in its bank when the target returns.
In Figure 11 , this lets SAM3RL reacquire the formula car that both SAM 3 and DAM4SAM3 lose.
In Figure 12 , SAM3RL reacquires the soldier’s hat, which DAM4SAM3 swaps for a distractor.
On the other hand, in Figure 13 , its bank retains frames showing the longboarder small and centered, but the rider returns large and on the left, so SAM3RL reacquires later than SAM 3 and DAM4SAM3.

appearance in memory throughout the gap and reacquires the hat on the first frame after
